WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total2013
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         ROUND((total2013 - total2012) * 100.0 / total2012, 2) AS increase_pct
  FROM seg
  WHERE total2012 > 0
)
SELECT Segment, increase_pct
FROM pct
WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM pct)
   OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM pct)
ORDER BY increase_pct DESC

sql:
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.molecule_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
  FROM atom AS a
  WHERE a.element = 'f'
) AS f ON f.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

sql:
WITH approved AS (
  SELECT e.expense_description, e.cost, b.category
  FROM expense AS e
  JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
  JOIN event AS ev ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
  WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
    AND e.approved = 'true'
),
items AS (
  SELECT TRIM(value) AS item, cost, category
  FROM approved, json_each('["' || REPLACE(expense_description, ', ', '","') || '"]')
)
SELECT item, category, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM items
GROUP BY item, category
ORDER BY category, item

sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A4 AS inhabitants
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) FROM account)
)
AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(d2.A4 AS INTEGER))
    FROM district AS d2
    WHERE d2.district_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
        FROM account AS a
        WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) FROM account)
    )
)
